profile.about: Connect and chat with me for anything engineering or entrepreneurship related, I'll buy…
recommendations: Runbo Li “Sarp interned at Magic Hour on the prototyping team and left a huge mark. He led development of multiple prototypes from scratch, and pitched in wherever the team needed support. He's a fast learner, a strong problem solver, and someone who shows up with a positive attitude no matter the challenge. Sarp has a rare mix of grit and humility that makes working with him a joy. I'd gladly work with him again, and I fully expect he'll go on to build amazing things.”

projects.description: A quantitative model for estimating password breachability given compute power, defined by Doven's compute constant.

projects.title: Rivet
projects.description: Rivet was an android-based app, in which high school students could view local profiles of their peers within their school and invite people to discussions, clubs, teams, and groups based on the qualifications on their profile.This filled the gap between experienced and avid highschool students and their inability to find the groups and clubs they are interested in.- Achieved Semi-Finalist at the Believe Leadership Inspiration Fair
